description: This file defines the LeaveRequestCommentAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing comments on leave requests within the OrangeHRM leave management module. It includes methods for listing, creating, and validating comments, with relevant annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for listing and creating comments on leave requests, implementing methods for handling HTTP GET and POST requests, validation, and authorization checks as part of the leave management module.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LeaveRequestCommentService instance used for comment data operations.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the leave request ID from the request URL parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list comments for a specific leave request, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing leave request comments, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new comment to a leave request, including validation and setting metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a leave request comment, primarily validating the comment text.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules such as positive integer check for leaveRequestId.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Populates a LeaveRequestComment entity with comment text and metadata like creation time and user info.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequestComment
methods.description: Persists the leave request comment entity using the associated DAO service.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception as delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws a not implemented exception as delete operation is not supported.
